This new patch comes with several role changes. The Wife, Doppleganger, Bounty Hunter, Stalker, Chatterbox, Mistress, Conman and Judge have all be slightly modified.

Due to these changes, any save made before this patch may be slightly affected. We apologies for any loss progress.
 
<align=center>For more information please see the patch notes.</align>
